snippet.title: BOOST VECTOR EX Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Run fast. Faster than any other.
WISHLIST HERE  If you like what you see :)
❗ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3832030

Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour anime racing. Hone your style with responsive flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. Chock full of single player story content, or multiplayer racing. Plenty to run by in the world of Vector Racing.

Boost Vector Ex is Blockage's seventh major game, being the spiritual (not so spiritual) sequel to Boost Vector. Solo developed by me, asmanwoks! 

Jump on our Discord to see updates and know when the game actually releases and more!

https://discord.gg/AEzBEZ3

Also available on the Epic games store to Wishlist ❗ https://store.epicgames.com/p/boost-vector-ex-1bb8f0

This lovely trailer was made by the talented @cirek 

Appearing on the 2026 Secret Sauce Showcase hosted by @offbrand-games !
